overview_description.description:
Packlink is an online platform that offers cost-effective package delivery services in Spain, Germany, France, Italy and internationally. 

Since 2015 Packlink also introduced a business solution which is called Packlink PRO to enable cost-effective package delivery for businesses.

It enables users to compare all available package delivery options offered by different service providers and pick a suitable service to get their parcels delivered.

Packlink was launched in January 2011.

product.name: Packlink Shipping Platform
product.description: An online platform that allows users to compare, book, and manage parcel shipments nationally and internationally without registration.

product.name: Packlink PRO
product.description: A platform tailored for businesses and e-commerce to automate, manage, and track national and international shipments from a single dashboard.

product.name: International Parcel Shipping Service
product.description: A service enabling users to send parcels internationally with support for customs documentation and multiple courier options.

product.name: National Parcel Shipping Service
product.description: A service for sending parcels within a country, offering comparison of courier options, home pickup, and tracking.
